goal: Launch reviewed local mobile QA server through feature:run and verify R04 UI using the authorized in-app browser, without deployment or source ownership expansion.
successCriteria: Preflight and dirty-input coverage pass before server startup.
Current bundle is visually reviewed on mobile viewports; native/live gates remain separate.
untouchedSurfaces: Canonical seed cards/decks are owned by the separate R20 executor; no edits to content JSON, Admin or provider prompts here.
Auth, Journal durable storage, entitlements, backend schemas, production and artwork exports remain unchanged.

impact.entryPoint: Explore and Tarot deck intro, quick Tarot shortcut, topic/spread/draw/result and Why expansion; retain tab and back history.
impact.dataWrite: Only local Expo development cache and fictional QA state; no code changes are granted by this launch scope and no schema/publisher mutation.
impact.backendContract: No API schema, provider call or quota rule changed; selected-card interpretation stays in the existing reading contract.
impact.adminVisibility: No Admin fields changed; current preview/live boundaries unaffected.
impact.privacySafety: Explain only actual app-selected cards and user question, do not invent why a provider chose a phrase; no new personal data, keys or telemetry.
impact.observability: Existing tarot_opened/quick_opened traces stay; explain label states symbolic seed explanation rather than a model chain of thought.
impact.rollback: Revert only scoped layout/flow changes to the reviewed App state; existing read/save payloads and card assets remain compatible.

canonicalContracts: Existing TarotStage, reading.cards/sourceSnapshot and canonical card meanings are preserved; explanation is displayed seed/context, not provider-private reasoning.
Open Reflection v1 and current A2UI/brand guidelines govern typography and artwork placement.

dependencyReview.evidence: Checked installed React Native 0.81.5 and current official versioned Image/layout documentation for contained absolute-fill image inside an aspect-ratio wrapper; no dependency changes.

Official layout aspectRatio contract; frame owns dimensions rather than static image metadata.

securityReview.authzRls: No authorization or server policy change; existing deck/credit checks remain, no free/Premium bypass introduced.
securityReview.sensitiveData: No saved user rows or private test data are read; synthetic browser scenarios only.
securityReview.secretsLogging: No env/credential/log changes or raw private history exported.
securityReview.externalInput: Question stays plain text; selected deck/card facts come from current canonical runtime data; Why cannot claim internal provider reasoning.
securityReview.dependencies: No install/update and no remote artwork; installed versions reviewed for the layout behavior.
securityReview.migrationRelease: No migration, database write, publish, deployment or native release action in this slice.

workingTreeReview.note: App-area scope is only for Expo cache/server operation. Source write ownership stays exact R04 App.tsx and R01 test handoffs; other preserved shared inputs are hash bound.

validationCommands: Authorized browser Tarot layout and intention flow review
managerTestPath: Explore a deck, see name/value without scrolling, start intention, choose spread without repeated deck picker, draw and expand Why to compare actual cards; save and begin a second reading.
